items.title: Fortinet Woes Continue With Another WAF Zero-Day Flaw

items.title: How to Solve Alert Overload in Your SOC
items.description: Your SOC generates thousands of alerts daily. Many of them are low-priority, repetitive, or false positives. On paper, this looks like a technical problem. In reality, it’s a business problem. Every Alert Costs When analysts are buried under thousands of notifications, they spend more time triaging noise than responding to real incidents. The result: slower reaction times, missed threats, staff…

items.title: ZDI-CAN-28552: Apple
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Michael DePlante (@izobashi) of Trend Zero Day Initiative' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-11-19, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-03-19 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
